title: Aftercare After SMP Treatment – Day-by-Day Guide

hero.heading: Aftercare After SMP Treatment – Day-by-Day Guide
hero.subtitle: Why is aftercare important?
bullets: Scalp micropigmentation (SMP) gives the effect of thick and natural hair – but only if properly cared for after the treatment.
This page provides you with clear and simple instructions to achieve the best result and ensure the pigment remains durable for years.

sections.title: Day-by-Day Guide
bullets: If you sweat – gently dab with a clean tissue
Outdoors: wear a cap or hat
Do not touch the treated area with your hands
Do not use cream/lotion on the same day

sections.title: Days 2–4
bullets: If needed, apply a mild alcohol-free moisturizer
Do not use razor, clipper, trimmer
Do not exercise, use sauna or solarium
Do not use any styling products

sections.title: Days 5–7
bullets: Wash your head with mild lukewarm shower (no rubbing)
Sunbathing and swimming in the sea

sections.title: After 7 days
bullets: Use SPF 50 cream – every time you stay outside for more than 10 minutes
Shaving (if you do) earliest after 10 days
text: Normal trimming routine (if you wear “buzz cut”):

sections.title: What to avoid for the next 4 weeks
bullets: Minoxidil (pause at least 7 days after each session)
text: If anything unexpected happens (itching, redness, sensitivity) – contact us immediately.

sections.title: Recommended products (on request)
text: At consultations, you will get precise recommendations for your skin.

list.a: Visually – 2–5 days. Completely – 7–10 days. During this time pigment stabilizes in the skin.

list.q: Can I wash my head every day after the first week?
list.a: Yes, but with mild products. Do not rub – rinse and pat dry.

list.q: Will the pigment fade if I don’t take care?
list.a: Fading, smudging, or uneven tone can occur. That’s why aftercare is crucial.
Don’t scratch! Dab with a dry tissue. Itching is a sign of healing.

finalCta.title: Have more questions?
finalCta.text: Feel free to contact us – we’re here to help even after the treatment. Satisfied clients are well-informed clients.
